profile.headline: Results-Driven Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Driven and focused, I am passionate about continuous self-enrichment in the ever-evolving field of Computer Science. After a decade of teaching English as a Second Language to adults, my love for problem-solving, patience, and dedication led me to embark on a career change.

I honed my coding skills at 42 Silicon Valley, immersing myself in peer-to-peer, project-based learning. The experience of coding projects for 14+ hours a day was not only challenging but immensely enjoyable.

I thrive on contributing to transformative projects using diverse tech stacks. 

Methodologies: Scrum, Agile
Database: Database Modeling, SQL, Elasticsearch, ETL, Database Design, Relational Data Modeling, GraphQL, Relational Databases
Microservices and Containers: Kubernetes, Docker
Collaboration and Version Control: Git
Cloud and DevOps: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), DevOps
Programming Languages: Python, PHP, Ruby
Big Data and Analytics: Google BigQuery, Apache Kafka, Google Data Studio
Microsoft Technologies: Microsoft SQL Server
Architectural Design: Software Architectural Design
Leadership: Team Leadership
Software Development and Quality Assurance: Software Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer II (L3)
positions.description:
• Led impactful Display Advertising Invoicing and Revenue Recognition project, automating processes and mitigating financial risks, resulting in an estimated impact of Display Ad Revenue between $3M to $3.5M monthly.
• Spearheaded automation initiatives beyond the Display Advertising project, resulting in a 15% overall improvement in workflow efficiency from previous processes.
• Enhanced project quality through active code reviews, ensuring high standards of code and development efficiency.
• Proactively addressed technical alerts, showcasing problem-solving skills and maintaining the system's stability.
• Managed critical tickets with strong project management, ensuring timely resolutions and contributing to 40-60% reduction in issue resolution time.
• Fostered cross-functional collaboration by actively engaging with teams outside the immediate scope, leading to a 20% increase in successful interdepartmental project implementations.

positions.title: Software Engineer II (L2)
positions.description:
• Successfully led SRC and IVT initiatives, enhancing system efficiency and reducing post-release issues by 20%, resulting in a 30% improvement in user satisfaction.
• Proactively addressed billing service errors, achieving a 95% supplier satisfaction rate and a 15% reduction in issue resolution time, bolstering supplier trust.
• Contributed to 80% of successful team implementations, reducing post-implementation issues by 30%, fostering a collaborative culture that boosted project success rates by 15%.
• Mentored three team members, improving their code quality by 25%, and led community engagement initiatives, increasing team morale and cohesion.
• Led PHP 8.1 Migration effort, updating 600+ files, reducing post-migration issues by 40%, ensuring a smooth transition to PHP 8.1, and saving 15% compared to the initial estimation.
• Provided constructive code reviews, improving overall code quality by 20%, and suggested process improvements, reducing project delivery times by 25%.
• Spearheaded initiatives to improve system scalability, resulting in a 25% increase in system capacity and accommodating growing user demands.
• Identified and implemented strategic process optimizations, streamlining workflows and contributing to a 20% reduction in development cycles.

positions.title: Software Engineer (L1)
positions.description:
• Played a pivotal role in the Revenue Management System, providing essential technical support and ensuring optimal functionality of customer-facing tools.
• Excelled in debugging complex issues, swiftly identifying root causes, and implementing effective solutions, resulting in 20-30% reduction in system downtime.
• Actively contributed to the system's evolution by introducing impactful features, directly addressing concerns raised by stakeholders and contributing to 100% improvement in user satisfaction.
• Collaborated seamlessly with cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and overall business objectives.
• Implemented proactive system monitoring measures, reducing the occurrence of critical issues and enhancing overall system stability.

positions.title: Junior React Native Developer
positions.description:
• Orchestrated the design and architecture of the React Native Vemidoc App, resulting in a 20% increase in app performance. The meticulous approach positively impacted overall efficiency.
• Contributed to the overhaul of UI/UX, achieving a 30% improvement in user satisfaction and app usability. The revamped design positively influenced the user experience.
• Assisted in the development and execution of project strategies, including documentation, contributing to a 50% reduction in development time. Strategic planning accelerated the development process.
• Implemented comprehensive strategies to enhance app performance, resulting in improved responsiveness and efficiency.
• Prioritized a user-centric design approach, ensuring the app met user expectations and contributed to increased satisfaction.
• Emphasized efficient project management for a more agile and responsive development cycle, enhancing overall productivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Design · Command Line · Data Migration · Bash · JavaScript · Agile Methodologies · Software Engineering · Git · Web Applications

positions.title: Content Rater
positions.description:
• Assessed the quality and accuracy of content presented via queries, utilizing proprietary software to maintain high standards of relevance and user satisfaction.
• Consistently met bi-weekly goals set by the company, showcasing efficiency and productivity in content evaluation.
• Stayed current with new implementations and tools, demonstrating adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
• Led classes through teaching the foundations of Java, creating easily digestible programs and games, fostering an engaging and interactive learning environment.
• Built on previous teaching assistant experience by providing valuable assistance to students and ensuring a comprehensive understanding of programming concepts.
• Incorporated interactive teaching methods, contributing to increased student participation, comprehension, and overall enjoyment of the learning process.
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-functional Team Leadership · Program Management · Java

positions.title: Spanish Interpreter
positions.description:
• Provided vital language support by facilitating communication between individuals and 9-1-1 operators during emergencies, ensuring swift and accurate assistance.
• Acted as a crucial intermediary, conveying information between patients and doctors before routine surgeries, contributing to clear and informed medical procedures.
• Interpreted for insurance agents, aiding customers in navigating the complexities of filing claims, managing a daily interpretation load of over 20 clients. Ensured precise communication in intricate situations, facilitating seamless interactions and resolution processes.

positions.title: ESL Coordinator
positions.description:
• Led 3 satellite schools for Progresso Learning, overseeing operations, and providing supervision, mentorship, and constructive feedback for a staff of over 20 instructors.
• Led the development of a standardized curriculum that became the company's staple teaching medium, establishing consistent instruction and methodology across all schools.
• Successfully implemented innovative teaching strategies, resulting in enhanced student engagement, improved learning outcomes, and a cohesive learning experience which increased monthly retention by 30%.

positions.title: ESL Teacher
positions.description:
• Spearheaded efforts to maintain and surpass monthly student retention rates by proactively identifying at-risk students. Delegated personalized maintenance instruction and follow-up, resulting in a notable increase in student retention and academic success from a 50% student retention month-over-month to a 70% retention rate month-over-month.
• Innovatively incorporated interactive teaching methods, fostering an engaging learning environment that significantly improved student participation and comprehension from a 20-minute overall student participation to a 60-minute overall student participation per class.
• Collaborated with colleagues to develop and implement curriculum enhancements, tailoring instructional materials to address the unique needs of ESL students, contributing to a more effective and inclusive learning experience.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with instructors to provide valuable assistance to summer camp students learning C++ and Java, facilitating engaging and educational lessons in classes with up to 30 campers.
• Fostered a positive learning environment by offering additional support to students, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of programming concepts on a 1 on 1 basis as needed.
• Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills, contributing to a smooth and enriching educational experience for camp participants.
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-functional Team Leadership · Program Management · Java

projects.title: Llamadocs Chat
projects.description:
Try it: https://llamadocschat.streamlit.app/

**You must provide your own OpenAI api key**

Description
I created the LlamaIndex Document Helper Chat Application, leveraging LlamaIndex—a Python library for large language models (LLMs)—to offer an interactive platform where users can learn about LlamaIndex through conversations with an AI assistant. This application simplifies accessing LlamaIndex's functionalities, improving user understanding and engagement.

Highlights:

Interactive Interface: Engage with an AI for insights on LlamaIndex.
Advanced AI: Utilizes LlamaIndex and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for accurate responses.
Easy Setup: Straightforward installation and user-friendly instructions.
Resourceful Sidebar: Quick access to developer info and professional links.

Innovations:

Pinecone Integration: Enhances response accuracy with vector similarity search.
Optimized Chat Engine: Ensures relevance and uniqueness in responses.

projects.title: 42 Unix Shell
projects.description:
• Developed a robust and feature-rich UNIX shell, named 42_Shell, during the coursework at 42 Silicon Valley in January 2018.
• Implemented standard features resembling a regular shell/terminal, including prompt display, basic line acquisition, and proper management of spaces and tabulations.
• Integrated essential builtins adhering to POSIX standards, such as cd, echo, exit, env, setenv, and unsetenv, each with its full set of features.
• Enabled simple execution of commands with arguments, efficient PATH management, and meticulous handling of errors and command return values.
• Incorporated advanced functionalities including redirections (">", ">>", "<", "|"), logical operators ("&&" and "||"), and the ";" separator.
• Compiled into the executable 42sh, showcasing proficiency in Unix shell development.
